invariants.title: Nothing is paid without an approved bill; nothing approves without a match on the record.
The 3-way match names its numbers; tolerance is config, breach is a refusal.
Stock enters only through a receipt; receipts are immutable facts.
Item cost is derived from receipts, never entered.
Vendor bank details are human-only; an agent can record a bill, never redirect money.
A disputed bill cannot be paid; dispute and resolution carry reasons.
PO prices freeze at issue; variances are shown, never averaged away.
Payments are recorded, never executed — no outbound rails.
The duplicate-bill guard surfaces warnings; it never auto-resolves them.
Over-receipt and over-billing are refusals naming the quantities.
Every write is a logged command with an actor; refusals are logged too.
Journal entries derive balanced: receipt to GRNI, approval to AP, payment to cash; COGS arrives with cost.
Goods received not invoiced is always visible — a real liability, not a residue.
